source.organization: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
source.document: Union Budget 2026-27 - Budget at a Glance
source.notes: Budget Estimates presented to Parliament. Values transcribed from the official Ministry of Finance PDF; individual items may not sum due to rounding.

revenue_receipts.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 1
revenue_receipts.definition: Revenue receipts of the Union Government.

tax_revenue_net.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 2
tax_revenue_net.definition: Tax revenue net to Centre after the States' share and specified transfers.

non_tax_revenue.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 3
non_tax_revenue.definition: Non-tax revenue receipts of the Union Government.

capital_receipts.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 4
capital_receipts.definition: Capital receipts including non-debt receipts, borrowings and other liabilities.

recovery_of_loans.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 5
recovery_of_loans.definition: Recovery of loans recorded as a capital receipt.

other_capital_receipts.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 6
other_capital_receipts.definition: Other capital receipts in the Budget at a Glance classification.

non_debt_capital_receipts.definition: Non-debt capital receipts, comprising recoveries of loans and other receipts in this summary.

borrowings_and_other_liabilities.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 7
borrowings_and_other_liabilities.definition: Borrowings and other liabilities; includes drawdown of cash balance.

non_borrowed_receipts.table: Arthrekha derivation from Budget at a Glance, page 1
non_borrowed_receipts.definition: Revenue receipts plus non-debt capital receipts.

total_receipts.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 8
total_receipts.definition: Total receipts including capital receipts and borrowing.

revenue_expenditure.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 10

capital_expenditure.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 13

total_expenditure.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 9
total_expenditure.definition: Total Union Government expenditure on revenue and capital accounts.

interest_payments.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 11
interest_payments.definition: Interest payments included in revenue expenditure.

grants_for_capital_assets.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 12
grants_for_capital_assets.definition: Grants in aid for creation of capital assets.

effective_capital_expenditure.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 14
effective_capital_expenditure.definition: Capital expenditure plus grants in aid for creation of capital assets.

revenue_deficit.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 15

effective_revenue_deficit.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 16
effective_revenue_deficit.definition: Revenue deficit minus grants in aid for creation of capital assets.

fiscal_deficit.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 17
fiscal_deficit.definition: Total expenditure minus revenue receipts, recovery of loans and other non-debt receipts.

primary_deficit.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, row 18

gross_tax_revenue.definition: Gross Union tax revenue before deductions and the States' share.

corporation_tax.definition: Corporation tax included in gross tax revenue.

income_tax.definition: Taxes on income included in gross tax revenue.

customs.definition: Customs duties included in gross tax revenue.

union_excise_duties.definition: Union excise duties included in gross tax revenue.

gst.definition: Goods and Services Tax included in gross tax revenue.

state_share_of_taxes.table: Receipts, page 6, deduction from gross tax revenue
state_share_of_taxes.definition: States' share deducted from gross tax revenue to arrive at tax revenue net to Centre.

pensions.definition: Pension expenditure in the Budget at a Glance major-items presentation.

defence_expenditure.definition: Defence expenditure in the Budget at a Glance major-items presentation.

central_sector_schemes.table: Expenditure of Government of India, page 8
central_sector_schemes.definition: Expenditure on Central Sector schemes and projects.

centrally_sponsored_schemes.table: Expenditure of Government of India, page 8

finance_commission_grants.table: Transfer of Resources to States and UTs, page 12
finance_commission_grants.definition: Grants provided under Finance Commission recommendations.

other_grants_loans_transfers.table: Expenditure of Government of India, page 8
other_grants_loans_transfers.definition: Other grants, loans and transfers in the broad expenditure classification.

tax_devolution_states.table: Transfer of Resources to States and UTs, page 12
tax_devolution_states.definition: Devolution of States' share in Union taxes.

total_transfers_states_uts.table: Transfer of Resources to States and UTs, page 12
total_transfers_states_uts.definition: Total transfers to States and Union Territories with legislature.

debt_receipts_net.table: Sources of Financing Fiscal Deficit, page 4
debt_receipts_net.definition: Net debt receipts used in financing the fiscal deficit.

market_borrowings_net.table: Sources of Financing Fiscal Deficit, page 4
market_borrowings_net.definition: Net market borrowings through government securities, after buyback and switching operations.

short_term_borrowing.table: Sources of Financing Fiscal Deficit, page 4

securities_against_small_savings.table: Sources of Financing Fiscal Deficit, page 4

external_debt_net.table: Sources of Financing Fiscal Deficit, page 4
external_debt_net.definition: Net external debt receipts used in deficit financing.

nominal_gdp.table: Budget at a Glance, page 1, note (i)
nominal_gdp.definition: Nominal GDP estimate for FY 2026-27 cited from NSO and used as the denominator for published deficit ratios.
